content.short: Hashlock provides security and smart contract auditing for enterprise and decentralized clients.
content.description: Hashlock is a blockchain security and smart contract auditing firm based in Australia. It serves both enterprise and decentralized clients to ensure their blockchain applications remain secure and trusted. The company emphasizes thorough security research and rigorous auditing practices, combining formal analysis, code reviews, and automated testing to identify potential vulnerabilities. In recent years, Hashlock has grown rapidly, expanding its capabilities and client base across multiple networks.
